description: Optimize and gate Event/Scene/Issue recall. Delivery is a hard gate, not the scored capability. Pass means a later message in 冬翔's DM can retrieve the same Issue from assoc_task by conversation_id.

scenarioGroups.title: Scene graph recall of the same Issue
scenarioGroups.why: The product is recall, not send. Robot inbound cid and outbound 冬翔 cid must both retrieve the Issue created for this marker. Assistant text is not a hit.

scenarioGroups.title: Recall ranking and alias robustness
scenarioGroups.why: A uid/staffId/openDingTalkId mismatch must not hide a cid hit. Recency and person match are rank signals. Keyword q is a filter, not a substitute for the graph.

scenarioGroups.title: Precision: wrong scene must not count as a hit
scenarioGroups.why: Robot cid ≠ 冬翔 DM cid. A news Issue on the robot scene is not proof that 冬翔's conversation recalled the eat matter.

scenarioGroups.title: Delivery is a gate for outbound recall
scenarioGroups.why: If 冬翔's DM has no DWS message, outbound recall cannot pass. Robot ack is not egress.

scenarioGroups.title: Coordinator ack is not a recall hit
scenarioGroups.why: The short loop may name the purpose and open an Issue. That sentence is not bind, send, or recall.
